top_signals.title: China Mega Banks, Insurers Seek at Least $53 Billion in Capital
top_signals.summary: China’s biggest banks and insurers are seeking at least 357 billion yuan ($53.2 billion) capital boost, with the Ministry of Finance footing more than 80% of the bill, as Beijing moves to shore up balance sheets and sustain growth in a slowing economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
